translations.web: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.
translations.bsb: So as Joab besieged the city, he assigned Uriah to a place where he knew the strongest enemy soldiers were.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
